value.text: Review round 2: formatting-sensitive source carving is a valid maintainability finding. General rule: runtime behavior tests must call stable executable boundaries, not locate internal code by whitespace or local variable spelling. Export side-effect-free reporting functions from both scripts, call the same functions from their guarded CLI entrypoints, and keep all existing cardinality/failure/real-SDK nongit assertions. Add a disposable-copy regression that runs those properties against LF, CRLF, alternate braces and renamed timing locals; it must fail with the old extraction reinstated. Audit found no other runtime TypeScript block extraction; Markdown example extraction and YAML workflow checks intentionally validate their source formats. The worktree is clean, the item is unclaimed/in_progress, and main has no newer commits; claim for this round without merging or redoing completed work.
